print_working_directory.Description: Print the current working directory of the default writable workspace.

list_root.Description: List top-level entries in the default writable workspace.

list_relative_path.Description: List the contents of a relative path located inside the default writable workspace.

path.Description: Relative path to inspect inside the writable workspace.

create_directory.Description: Create a subdirectory inside the default writable workspace and return its resolved path.

path.Description: Relative directory path to create inside the writable workspace.

windows.Script: $target = {{path}}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target -Force | Out-Null; Resolve-Path $target | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path

delete_directory.Description: Ensure a workspace directory is absent. Recursively deletes an existing directory; an already-absent path succeeds. A file target or deletion failure is an error. Explicit configured path preconditions still apply.

path.Description: Relative directory path to remove; it may already be absent.

windows.Script: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $target = {{path}}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -ErrorAction Stop) { $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if (-not $item.PSIsContainer -or ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw 'Target must be a directory, not a file or link.' }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -ErrorAction Stop) { throw 'Directory is still present.' }; Write-Output "absent: $target"

cat_file.Description: Print the contents of a file inside the default writable workspace.

path.Description: Relative file path to read inside the writable workspace.

grep_recursive.Description: Search for a text pattern recursively in the default writable workspace.

pattern.Description: Text or regex pattern to search for.

find_files.Description: Find files by name pattern in the default writable workspace.

tree.Description: Display the directory tree structure of a relative path in the writable workspace.

write_file.Description: Create or overwrite any text file inside the default writable workspace. The content must be provided as UTF-8 base64.

path.Description: Relative file path to create inside the writable workspace.

contentBase64.Description: File content encoded as UTF-8 base64.

windows.Script: $target = {{path}}; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $target; if ($parent) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null }; $content = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String({{contentBase64}})); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($target, $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); Write-Output $target

delete_file.Description: Delete a file inside the default writable workspace.

path.Description: Relative file path to delete inside the writable workspace.

windows.Script: $target = {{path}}; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Leaf)) { throw "File not found: $target" }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force; Write-Output $target

head_file.Description: Print the first N lines of a file in the writable workspace.

tail_file.Description: Print the last N lines of a file in the writable workspace.

wc.Description: Count lines, words, and characters of a file in the writable workspace.

copy_file.Description: Copy a workspace file. The destination is the exact new path and must not exist; its parent must exist. No overwrite or directory merging. Links are not supported.

destination.Description: Exact relative destination file path; must not exist, with an existing parent.

windows.Script: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = {{source}}; $destination = {{destination}}; $source = $source.TrimEnd('\','/'); $destination = $destination.TrimEnd('\','/'); $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $source -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Links are not supported.' }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -ErrorAction Stop) { throw 'Destination already exists.' }; $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($destination); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container -ErrorAction Stop)) { throw 'Destination parent must exist.' }; if ($item.PSIsContainer) { throw 'Source must be a file.' }; [System.IO.File]::Copy($source, $destination, $false); Write-Output $destination

copy_directory.Description: Copy a workspace directory recursively. The destination is the exact new path and must not exist; its parent must exist. No overwrite or directory merging. Links are not supported.

destination.Description: Exact relative destination directory path; must not exist, with an existing parent.

windows.Script: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = {{source}}; $destination = {{destination}}; $source = $source.TrimEnd('\','/'); $destination = $destination.TrimEnd('\','/'); $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $source -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Links are not supported.' }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -ErrorAction Stop) { throw 'Destination already exists.' }; $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($destination); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container -ErrorAction Stop)) { throw 'Destination parent must exist.' }; if (-not $item.PSIsContainer) { throw 'Source must be a directory.' }; if ($destination.Equals($source, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or $destination.StartsWith($source + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Destination must be outside the source directory.' }; function Assert-Tree([string]$path) { foreach ($entry in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction Stop) { if ($entry.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Source contains links.' }; if ($entry.PSIsContainer) { Assert-Tree $entry.FullName } } }; Assert-Tree $source; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; function Copy-Contents([string]$from, [string]$to) { foreach ($entry in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $from -Force -ErrorAction Stop) { if ($entry.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Source contains links.' }; $target = [System.IO.Path]::Combine($to, $entry.Name); if ($entry.PSIsContainer) { [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($target) | Out-Null; Copy-Contents $entry.FullName $target } else { [System.IO.File]::Copy($entry.FullName, $target, $false) } } }; Copy-Contents $source $destination; Write-Output $destination

move_file.Description: Move a workspace file. The destination is the exact new path and must not exist; its parent must exist. No overwrite or directory merging. Links are not supported. Move also renames.

destination.Description: Exact relative destination file path; must not exist, with an existing parent.

windows.Script: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = {{source}}; $destination = {{destination}}; $source = $source.TrimEnd('\','/'); $destination = $destination.TrimEnd('\','/'); $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $source -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Links are not supported.' }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -ErrorAction Stop) { throw 'Destination already exists.' }; $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($destination); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container -ErrorAction Stop)) { throw 'Destination parent must exist.' }; if ($item.PSIsContainer) { throw 'Source must be a file.' }; [System.IO.File]::Move($source, $destination); Write-Output $destination

move_directory.Description: Move a workspace directory recursively. The destination is the exact new path and must not exist; its parent must exist. No overwrite or directory merging. Links are not supported. Move also renames.

destination.Description: Exact relative destination directory path; must not exist, with an existing parent.

windows.Script: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = {{source}}; $destination = {{destination}}; $source = $source.TrimEnd('\','/'); $destination = $destination.TrimEnd('\','/'); $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $source -Force -ErrorAction Stop; if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Links are not supported.' }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -ErrorAction Stop) { throw 'Destination already exists.' }; $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($destination); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container -ErrorAction Stop)) { throw 'Destination parent must exist.' }; if (-not $item.PSIsContainer) { throw 'Source must be a directory.' }; if ($destination.Equals($source, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or $destination.StartsWith($source + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Destination must be outside the source directory.' }; function Assert-Tree([string]$path) { foreach ($entry in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction Stop) { if ($entry.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'Source contains links.' }; if ($entry.PSIsContainer) { Assert-Tree $entry.FullName } } }; Assert-Tree $source; [System.IO.Directory]::Move($source, $destination); Write-Output $destination
